nodes.label: Towards Verifiable and Self-Correcting AI Physicists for Quantum Many-Body Simulations
nodes.author: Ken Deng et al.

nodes.label: QMP-Bench (100-task quantum many-body physics benchmark)
nodes.rationale: Built from 21 published quantum-many-body-physics papers rather than curated toy problems to test genuine reproduction ability.

nodes.label: PhysVEC (Author/Programming-verifier/Scientific-verifier framework)
nodes.rationale: Separates programming correctness (unit/integration tests) from physical/scientific validity (rubric, physical-assertion, convergence tests) because a script can execute without error while being physically wrong.
